facts.fact: 童年旧友 Sienna Hartley 敲车窗现身，把进退两难的 Max 吓了一跳，之后一路推她下车办入住。
facts.anchor: It’s the sharp tap against my window that startles me, my hand flying to my chest.

facts.fact: Sienna 自我介绍：如今是 FBI 探员，正争取调入行为分析部门（BAU），ASAC 迟迟不定她的派驻地。
B&B 老板娘 Leah Trott 把她当名作家热情接待——助手 Kaia 把行程报给了民宿，笔名 Max Usher 当场暴露。
facts.anchor: your assistant called earlier to ask if you’d arrived since she couldn’t reach you on your cell.

facts.fact: Sienna 点出 Fairhope 已被士绅化、开始有游客，不再是两人小时候的小镇。
facts.anchor: A lot has changed in Fairhope. It’s not the same little town we grew up in.

facts.fact: 高中时一群女生模仿电影 Heathers 组成 The Fairhope Reds，靠恐惧与羞辱统治 Fairhope High。
facts.anchor: a group of girls began calling themselves The Fairhope Reds as an homage to the clique in the movie.

facts.fact: Reds 领袖成为 Milo 继姐的那一年，正是 Max 受折磨开始的那一年。
facts.anchor: the year the Red’s fearless leader became Milo’s stepsister, and the year my torment began

facts.fact: 楼梯口撞上 Jordan Richfield——选美皇后做派，如今是波特兰的 ACC 天气主播，假意寒暄。
facts.anchor: Standing there, in all her American beauty queen glory, is Jordan Richfield.

facts.fact: Jordan 手腕上的红绳（Reds 的标志，模仿电影里的红色发圈）瞬间把 Max 拉回创伤。
facts.anchor: The red fucking string tied around her wrist.

facts.fact: Jordan 擦身而过时低声骂她 Freak——Max 微笑着说这是 Fairhope 的人给过她最好的称呼。
